description: Build real Red/Blue team queueing+lobby for the range (reusing the existing teams/team_members/matchmaking_queue tables and matchmaking pattern from src/app/api/matchmaking/route.ts), wire a full match lifecycle on top of FEAT-002's orchestrator (spin up container on pairing, proxy player requests to it, run the scorer against the live container, end the match on timeout/vault-zero/boss-exploit), and add the live match API surface: proxied attack console, patch console (writes to the running container's tmpfs + restart), team activity feed, and SSE event feed. Depends on FEAT-001 (target app/exploit tests used by the scorer) and FEAT-002 (orchestrator, kill switch, range_target_matches).
steps: Add src/app/range/layout.tsx calling `await requireUser({ profile: true })` from src/lib/guards.ts (existing, unmodified) — the single new auth gate for every page under /range/**, following the exact pattern of src/app/demo/matchmaking/layout.tsx.

Add a new API route src/app/api/range/queue/route.ts (POST) that mirrors src/app/api/matchmaking/route.ts's atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE pairing logic but is range-specific: on successful pairing of a RED and a BLUE team (minimum size configurable via an env var, default 2), call orchestrator.startMatch() from FEAT-002, insert the range_target_matches + match_sessions rows, and return the new match/session id to both sides.

Add src/app/api/range/[matchId]/proxy/route.ts: an authenticated (getCurrentUser() + team-membership check against match_sessions/team_members, same join pattern as src/app/api/lab/route.ts) reverse-proxy route that forwards the Red team's attack requests to the match's target container by resolving the container's internal IP via orchestrator/dockerClient inspect, never exposing that IP to the client; every proxied request/response is logged via recordAuditLog tagged with matchId and the acting user's id (never email) — this is the 'shared proxied attack console, all logged per-player'.

Add src/app/api/range/[matchId]/patch/route.ts (POST, Blue-only via team-membership+side check): accepts a file path (constrained to an allowlist of target source files) and new content, calls orchestrator's exec-based patch mechanism (from FEAT-002's tmpfs/exec design) to write the file into the running container's tmpfs and trigger the target's restart, and records a RANGE_PATCH_APPLIED audit log entry.

Add src/lib/range-runtime/scorer.ts: on an interval (e.g. every 5s) for each ACTIVE range match, call a `/health` check against the proxied target URL, and only if healthy, run the same exploit-proof check functions used in tests/range-target/exploits.test.ts (refactored into small exported functions importable from both the test file and the scorer, so there is one source of truth) against the live container; record RANGE_EXPLOIT_LANDED / RANGE_EXPLOIT_BLOCKED audit log rows and update range_target_matches.vault_balance_cents from the real vault balance read off the live container; if the boss exploit succeeds (vault hits 0) or the match timeout elapses, end the match (stop the container via orchestrator.stopMatch(), set match_sessions/range_target_matches to ENDED, write a RANGE_MATCH_ENDED summary row/audit entry including MVP-per-team derived from each user's own count of RANGE_EXPLOIT_LANDED/RANGE_PATCH_APPLIED entries).

Add src/app/api/range/[matchId]/events/route.ts: a Server-Sent-Events Route Handler (ReadableStream, `Content-Type: text/event-stream`) that, after the same membership/auth check as the proxy route, streams new audit_logs rows tagged with this matchId (polling the DB on a short interval inside the stream and pushing only new rows since the last sent id/timestamp) to the client — this is the 'real-time event feed' and 'team activity feed' data source, reusing audit_logs as the single source of truth per ASSUMPTIONS.md.

Add a team activity feed filter: within the same SSE route (or a query param), let Red see only RED-tagged events and Blue see only BLUE-tagged events for the 'what teammates are probing / what Blue just patched' feeds, while the spectator view (separate route or a `role=spectator` query param, no team-membership check needed since it's read-only aggregate data, still requires getCurrentUser() so it stays behind login) sees the combined vault-balance/score/event feed only.

Write tests/rangeQueueAndMatch.test.ts in the MAIN tests/ dir (DB-level, following tests/matchLifecycle.test.ts's seeding style, no real Docker container needed — stub/skip the orchestrator's Docker calls behind a small interface so this test exercises only the DB/queue/membership logic) covering: pairing two teams of the minimum size starts a match row, a non-member is forbidden from the proxy/patch routes, and ending a match frees both teams the same way endMatch() does today.
acceptance_criteria: Red+Blue teams of 2+ can queue and get paired into a live match, each side only through src/app/range/** pages gated by the new layout.tsx
the attack console and patch console routes work only for authenticated members of the correct team/side for that specific match, and reject everyone else with 403
the scorer updates vault_balance_cents and writes audit_logs rows based on real HTTP probes against the live container, never a timer-faked value
the SSE events route delivers real audit_logs-backed events to a connected client and closes cleanly when the match ends
a match ends on timeout, vault-zero, or an operator kill, in every case via orchestrator.stopMatch() and a terminal match_sessions/range_target_matches status
tests/rangeQueueAndMatch.test.ts passes as part of the normal `npm test`
verification: PATH=.tools/node22/bin:$PATH npm test — new DB-level queue/match tests pass alongside all existing tests

PATH=.tools/node22/bin:$PATH npm run test:range-target — scorer's shared exploit-check functions still pass when imported directly by the exploit-proof tests (proves the refactor in this feature didn't change exploit-test behavior)

manual end-to-end smoke check: start the dev server is NOT required for this — instead run a short Node script (or extend the isolation self-test) that starts one real match via the queue route logic (2 stub red + 2 stub blue users seeded directly in the test DB), drives one scorer tick against the live container, and confirms a vault_balance_cents change and an audit_logs row appear; then stop the match and confirm the container/network are gone
PATH=.tools/node22/bin:$PATH npm run build — passes, only run when `npm run dev` is not running
git commit this section's changes as one commit
findings: Lobby/scorer/routes added. DB-only logic in src/lib/range-runtime/lobby.ts (no Docker): joinRangeQueue(userId,teamId,min=RANGE_MIN_TEAM_SIZE||2) -> {kind:forbidden|not_found|too_small|busy|queued|matched{sessionId,created}}, creates match_sessions mode='RANGE' (old /api/matchmaking uses mode 'TEAM'; both share matchmaking_queue so a range-queued team could in theory be paired by the old route); getMatchAccess(userId,sessionId)->{side,matchActive,range}|null (side from DB); rangeTag(sessionId,scope)='[range:<id>:RED|BLUE|ALL]' prefixes every range audit row's details (RED: RANGE_PROXY_REQUEST; BLUE: RANGE_PATCH_APPLIED; ALL: RANGE_MATCH_PAIRED/EXPLOIT_LANDED/EXPLOIT_BLOCKED/MATCH_ENDED/MATCH_FAILED); recordRangeEvent(); getRangeEvents(sessionId,'RED'|'BLUE'|'SPECTATOR',afterRowid) (spectator = ALL rows, no user names); endRangeSession(sessionId,reason,stopFn) = orchestrator stop + endMatch() + one RANGE_MATCH_ENDED summary (winner RED on vault-zero, none on kill, else BLUE; mvp_red/mvp_blue = user id + count of RANGE_EXPLOIT_LANDED / RANGE_PATCH_APPLIED). Containers have no host-reachable port, so requests go through exec: targetHttp.ts requestTarget(containerId,{method,path,body,cookie}) runs node http inside the container; containerTransport(containerId) adapts it to the shared Transport; patchTargetFile(containerId,file in [server.js,db.js],content) does node --check, writes /app/<file> in the tmpfs and SIGTERMs `node server.js` so the entrypoint loop restarts it (a patch resets the target's in-memory DB/vault/sessions). exploitChecks.ts is the single source of truth (pure, no Docker/DB): checkSqliLogin/checkIdor/checkNegativeTransfer/checkOpenAdmin/checkVaultSweep/readVaultBalance/checkHealth over a Transport; probes are non-destructive (negative self-transfer of -1, vault sweep with toId 0 expecting 400). tests/range-target/exploits.test.ts now also calls them. scorer.ts: scoreTick(sessionId,{transport?,stop?}) health-checks, reads vault into range_target_matches.vault_balance_cents, runs the five probes, writes RANGE_EXPLOIT_LANDED (once per player per exploit, credited to the Red user whose proxied 2xx request hit that exploit path while the probe confirms it open) and RANGE_EXPLOIT_BLOCKED (on open->blocked transition, credited to the latest Blue patcher, or first observation blocked), ends on vault 0 or timeout; reconcileEndedMatches() ends RANGE sessions whose range match went terminal via orchestrator timeout/kill; ensureScorerRunning() starts a 5s unref'd interval (globalThis-shared) and is called by every range route. Routes (all runtime nodejs, getCurrentUser first): POST /api/range/queue {teamId} (profile required, 30/min; on pairing calls startMatch, on failure releases both teams and returns 502); POST /api/range/<sessionId>/proxy {method GET|POST,path,body?,cookie?} Red-only (403 otherwise), returns {status,contentType,body,cookie}, logs RANGE_PROXY_REQUEST with method/path/status only, cookie must match fc_sid=hex; POST /api/range/<sessionId>/patch {file,content} Blue-only, 422 on syntax error, logs RANGE_PATCH_APPLIED; GET /api/range/<sessionId>/events SSE (events: vault, audit, end), members get own-team feed, ?role=spectator any logged-in user gets ALL-only feed; stream polls 1s and closes after sending 'end' once match_sessions is not ACTIVE. src/app/range/layout.tsx = requireUser({profile:true}); no pages yet (FEAT-004 adds them). guards/session/middleware untouched. Ran (PATH=.tools/node22/bin): npm test -> 47/47 pass (39 + 8 new in tests/rangeQueueAndMatch.test.ts: pairing, min size, non-member/side access, end frees teams, reconcile after timeout, feed filtering, scorer with stub transport incl. vault-zero/MVP/timeout); npm run test:range-target -> 13/13 pass (7 exploit tests now using shared checks, 5 isolation, 1 new tests/range-target/liveMatch.test.ts on a REAL container: queue pairing -> startMatch -> proxied attack requests -> scoreTick vault 50,000,000 and 5 exploits open -> live patch of /internal/admin/accounts + syntax-error patch rejected -> tick shows open-admin BLOCKED -> boss sweep -> tick reads vault 0, ends match, teams freed, summary winner=RED, container+network gone); npm run build -> OK (no dev server running; all new routes listed). docker ps -a / network ls afterwards show only pre-existing buildx_buildkit_default and bridge, nothing to clean. NOT exercised: the HTTP route handlers themselves (auth cookies, SSE stream) were not hit over HTTP since no dev server was run; their logic is in lobby/scorer/targetHttp which are tested.
